reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a supposedly free and easy flash-loan arbitrage method that directs participants to deploy a contract, transfer 98 FTM or more, and authorize MetaMask transactions. It pairs that asset flow with a reported approximately $1,200 return, creating a concrete rapid-profit solicitation. The general warning about flash-loan exploits does not negate the video's separate promotion of participation and claimed return.

citations.quote: FTM / FREE No Code Flash Loan Arbitrage Bot!
We'll deploy a new smart contract to the Fantom FTM Chain using remix and swap tokens on Pancakeswap and Uniswap.
Send FTM to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 98 FTM (110 FTM up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap)
Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask.
now i need to supply this contract slash coin with enough gas to be able to arbitrage trade back and forth with itself

opening.argument: The presentation includes an explicit risk warning rather than treating the activity as safe or guaranteed: it states that flash-loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable protocols and steal millions. That warning gives viewers a material reason to investigate the risks before acting. The instructions also describe a specific blockchain transaction process, not a promise that every participant will profit. A creator who openly highlights serious exploit risk is better understood as cautioning viewers about a technical activity than deceptively certifying effortless returns.

citations.quote: flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.
A flash loan has to be borrowed and repaid within the same blockchain transaction.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited 98-FTM instruction shows an operational funding step, but it does not establish that the creator receives the funds or guarantees a return. The reported result is also presented as a personal demonstration, while the same description warns that flash-loan exploits can cause major losses. Those cautions materially qualify the promotional interpretation.

citations.quote: Send FTM to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 98 FTM (110 FTM up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap)
flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A warning that exploits exist does not turn the rest of the presentation into a safety disclaimer. The instructions still tell viewers to deploy a contract, fund it with FTM, and confirm MetaMask transactions. The risk language concerns third-party protocol exploits, while the video separately presents a rapid profit outcome from following its own workflow.

citations.quote: Send FTM to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 98 FTM (110 FTM up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap)
Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask.
That's $1400 we just bought right there

opening.argument: The dominant format is an educational, step-by-step technical demonstration. The description lays out numbered setup, compilation, deployment, funding, and execution steps, while the narration explains MetaMask, Remix, the compiler version, and how arbitrage is supposed to work. The sampled frames likewise show a code editor and deployment interface rather than a conventional sales page. Showing a personal test and explaining the mechanics of smart-contract interaction is consistent with technology education or demonstration, even if the speaker describes an observed result.

citations.quote: Step By Step Tutorial for Flash Loan:
I am trying to make it as easy as I can for you to follow along.
we got to deploy our own token or Contract on the FTM Chain

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling it a tutorial does not by itself prove deception. The supplied material emphasizes how to configure Remix, choose compiler version 0.5.16, deploy a contract, and execute a transaction. The result is framed as the demonstrator's own experience, not as a formal guarantee that every viewer will obtain the same amount.

citations.quote: Step By Step Tutorial for Flash Loan:
my Solidity compiler version is 00. 5.16
That's $1400 we just bought right there

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Technical instruction can still function as solicitation when it directs viewers through the exact funding and transaction sequence. Here, the tutorial does more than explain concepts: it identifies the amount to send, tells viewers to confirm MetaMask, and celebrates a claimed $1,200 profit. Educational formatting does not erase that concrete call to participate.

citations.quote: Send FTM to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 98 FTM (110 FTM up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap)
Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask.
we only made like 1,200 but still 1,200 is fucking sweet

opening.argument: The evidence is also consistent with an ordinary technical service or software workflow, not a classic deposit-for-return scam. The material describes deploying a smart contract, connecting MetaMask, and trading token pairs across decentralized exchanges. It does not establish that viewers pay the presenter, surrender account credentials, recruit others, or receive a contractual guarantee. The supplied frames show development and wallet interfaces, but they do not establish who controlled the funds or whether the displayed balance difference came from the demonstrated transaction. Those missing mechanisms matter before labeling the content fraudulent.

citations.quote: We'll deploy a new smart contract to the Fantom FTM Chain using remix and swap tokens on Pancakeswap and Uniswap.
source code will also be in the video description

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of a smart contract and decentralized exchanges does not establish ordinary commerce or safety, but it also does not establish that the presenter solicits a deposit into a personal account. The evidence shows a technical workflow and a displayed result, while leaving the ownership and causation of the balance movement unresolved. That uncertainty weighs against treating the demonstration as proven fraud.

citations.quote: We'll deploy a new smart contract to the Fantom FTM Chain using remix and swap tokens on Pancakeswap and Uniswap.
now i need to supply this contract slash coin with enough gas

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing elements identified by the defense are not required for this category. The relevant mechanism is a viewer-directed transfer into a deployed contract followed by a claimed rapid return. The instructions expressly tell viewers to send 98 FTM or more and confirm transactions, while the narration reports approximately $1,200 in profit. That is sufficient to show a funded-contract return pitch even without recruitment or credential theft.
